# Gangadevi Jeyaraj

> Senior Agentic AI Engineer and CPO at Enthiram.ai. Portfolio and field notes on enterprise agentic AI.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/): work history, projects, research and contact

## Blog

- [What Is a Fractional AI Engineer, and When Should You Hire One Instead of a Full-Time Engineer?](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/what-is-a-fractional-ai-engineer-when-to-hire.html): A fractional AI engineer gives you senior AI expertise part-time. What they do, when hiring one beats a full-time hire, how engagements work and what they cost.
- [Hiring a Fractional Senior AI Engineer in Singapore, the UK, the US or Bangalore: How It Works and What It Costs](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/hire-fractional-senior-ai-engineer-singapore-uk-us-bangalore.html): How to hire a fractional senior AI engineer across Singapore, the UK, the US and Bangalore: engagement models, time zones, rates and what to look for in each market.
- [Fractional AI Engineer vs Full-Time Hire vs Consultancy: Which Is Right for Your Agentic AI Project?](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/fractional-ai-engineer-vs-full-time-vs-consultancy.html): Fractional AI engineer, full-time hire or AI consultancy? A senior AI engineer compares cost, speed, ownership and risk so you can choose the right one for your project.
- [Is Your Multi-Agent System Forgetting Its Own Rules? How I Fix Context Rot in Enterprise AI Agents](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/context-rot-context-engineering-multi-agent-systems.html): Context rot makes long-running AI agents drift away from enterprise policy. A senior agentic AI engineer explains where it happens and how to engineer it out.
- [Finding Out a Day Late? Event-Driven Anomaly Detection with Kafka and AI Agents](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/event-driven-anomaly-detection-kafka-ai-agents.html): Batch reports find fraud and outages the next morning. How I design Kafka-based anomaly detection where AI agents triage and act within seconds.
- [Why Do Your AI Agents Give Three Answers to One Question? Build an Enterprise Ontology and Semantic Knowledge Layer](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/enterprise-ontology-semantic-knowledge-layer-ai-agents.html): AI agents contradict each other when "customer" means three things in three systems. How to build an enterprise ontology and semantic layer that fixes it.
- [Your AI Agents Are Only as Good as the Data They Can Reach: Designing a Unified Enterprise Data Fabric](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/unified-enterprise-data-fabric-for-ai-agents.html): Enterprise AI agents stall when data sits in forty systems with forty access rules. How I design a data fabric that gives agents governed, trusted data.
- [Can Your AI Agent Survive a Five-Day Task? Engineering Long-Running Autonomous Agent Execution](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/long-running-autonomous-agent-execution.html): Most AI agents fail when a task outlives one session. How I engineer long-running autonomous agents with durable execution, safe retries and human approval.
- [Your Enterprise Chatbot Answers Questions. Your Staff Need It to Finish the Task.](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/enterprise-agentic-chat-conversational-intelligence.html): Most enterprise chatbots stop at answers. How I design agentic chat that respects permissions, cites sources, completes tasks and learns from conversations.
- [Why Does Your AI Agent Remember the Wrong Things? A Practical Agent Memory Architecture](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/agent-memory-architecture-memory-management.html): AI agents forget decisions and cling to stale facts because memory was bolted on. A practical agent memory architecture with write, read and forget paths.
- [Your AI Agents Come from Five Vendors and Cannot Work Together: A2A, MCP and Multi-Agent Coordination](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/a2a-multi-agent-interoperability-coordination.html): Agents from different vendors drop tasks, duplicate work and lose rules at handoff. How I design A2A communication, interoperability and coordination.
- [If You Cannot See What Your AI Agent Did, You Cannot Trust It: Agent Observability and Continuous Evaluation](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/agent-observability-continuous-evaluation.html): Agents pass the demo and fail quietly in production. How I set up agent observability and continuous evaluation: traces, release gates and online scoring.
- [Your Core System Is Twenty Years Old and Has No API. AI Agents Can Still Work with It.](https://gangadevijeyaraj-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/legacy-application-modernisation-agentic-integration.html): Rewriting a core system takes years and often fails. How I modernise legacy applications with agentic integration: wrap them as tools, then replace in steps.
